additional_info.subject: ID0479560-DC/Si-D/CH- [MP / R7 170002201] CanCommLoss CRM:03289000608
additional_info.body:
Hi Alex,
Sorry I was very busy the whole day but at least I want to give you a reply.
It doesn't seem to be related to a specific group, it is indeed strange that so many of them have this issue, specially because the error is showing CanCommLoss but we have the Serial Number which is shared via CAN, weird.
I also see that we don't have Power Save mode so that cannot be.
For this case I can only recommend to try a reboot or to go to site with a couple of converters and see if the problem is related to cabling or really converters.
I recommend taking spare KF11 since it's the CAN communication to converters, extra converters (how many as you wish, they are 7 in bad state).
I will move this to your queue but feel free to reach out to me via Teams.
Thanks!
BEst regards,
Francisco

additional_info.subject: ID0479560-DC/Si-D/CH- [MP / R7 170002201] CanCommLoss CRM:03289000608
additional_info.body:
Hi Alex,
After you rebooted the charger this morning it's working again. From the symptoms, it seems like the error which was shown in the Regular Touchpoint meeting where the converter loses Can communication.
I would say to close this ticket and if it reoccurs, we can reopen a ticket and check if the BETA version which most likely has this fixed already, can be the solution.
Let me know your feedback.
BR,
Francisco
